subtitle: Healthcare AI Journey
source_note: Editable baseline curriculum verified against the official Coursera course pages listed in source_catalog. It contains course and module names only. Coursera quizzes, labs, assignments, and exercises are intentionally excluded. No runtime scraping is required.

roadmap.title: IBM Data Science Professional Certificate
roadmap.target_competency: Comfortable using Python, NumPy, Pandas, SQL, data cleaning, EDA, visualization, Jupyter, and the Data Science workflow.

roadmap.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning Specialization
roadmap.target_competency: Understand the mathematics behind regression, gradient descent, neural networks, dimensionality reduction, and optimization.

roadmap.title: Statistics with Python Specialization
roadmap.target_competency: Reason about uncertainty, sampling, inference, hypothesis testing, and statistical regression using Python.

roadmap.title: Machine Learning Specialization
roadmap.target_competency: Understand the full problem-to-generalization workflow, not only how to call fit() and predict().

roadmap.title: Deep Learning Specialization
roadmap.target_competency: Understand forward propagation, loss calculation, backpropagation, gradient updates, optimization, CNNs, and sequence models.

roadmap.title: Introduction to Healthcare
roadmap.target_competency: Understand healthcare stakeholders, delivery, financing, access, quality, costs, and the context in which clinical data is generated.

roadmap.title: Medical Terminology Specialization
roadmap.target_competency: Read basic clinical datasets, EHR fields, medical papers, and healthcare documentation without being blocked by basic terminology.

roadmap.title: Epidemiology for Public Health Specialization
roadmap.target_competency: Frame healthcare questions using incidence, prevalence, risk, study design, bias, confounding, and causal reasoning.

roadmap.title: Biostatistics in Public Health Specialization
roadmap.target_competency: Apply and interpret statistical methods in public-health and clinical-research contexts.

roadmap.title: Clinical Data Science Specialization
roadmap.target_competency: Understand how clinical information is represented, extracted, cleaned, and analyzed in EHR and healthcare datasets.

roadmap.title: AI in Healthcare Specialization — Continued
roadmap.target_competency: Evaluate whether AI is safe, fair, clinically useful, and compatible with healthcare workflows.

roadmap.title: AI for Medicine Specialization
roadmap.target_competency: Apply ML and DL to diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment while using clinically meaningful evaluation.

roadmap.title: Informed Clinical Decision Making Using Deep Learning
roadmap.target_competency: Reason about clinical prediction, EHR modeling, explainability, calibration, fairness, and decision support.

roadmap.title: Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) Specialization
roadmap.target_competency: Build, deploy, and operate reliable machine learning services across CI/CD pipelines, cloud platforms, and scalable model-serving systems.

milestones.title: General Data Science / AI Foundation
milestones.competency_criteria: Python; Pandas, NumPy, SQL; cleaning, EDA, visualization; linear algebra and calculus for ML; probability and inference; classical ML; neural networks; training, validation, and error analysis.

milestones.title: Healthcare Literacy
milestones.competency_criteria: Healthcare stakeholders and delivery; patient journey; medical terminology; basic clinical records; understands that the goal is clinical literacy rather than medical practice.

milestones.title: Healthcare Data Science Foundation
milestones.competency_criteria: Epidemiology; biostatistics; clinical data and EHR; healthcare AI context, evaluation, workflow, safety, fairness, and clinical usefulness.

milestones.title: Medical AI & Deployment
milestones.competency_criteria: Diagnosis, prognosis, treatment modeling; clinical decision support; calibration, fairness, explainability; MLOps; one strong independent end-to-end Healthcare AI portfolio project.
